title: LoL: Hanwha Life Esports vs T1 (BO3) - LCK Rounds 1-2
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Hanwha Life Esports and T1 in the LCK Rounds 1-2, initially scheduled for May 1 at 6:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Hanwha Life Esports" if Hanwha Life Esports win the match against T1.

This market will resolve to "T1" if T1 win the match against Hanwha Life Esports.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: **Hanwha Life Esports enters as LCK Rounds 1-2 leaders with an 8-1 series record and 16-4 game differential, fresh off a 2-0 sweep of co-leader KT Rolster on April 29 that snapped KT's unbeaten streak and solidified HLE's top spot.** T1 holds third at 6-3 (13-6 games), rebounding with a recent 2-0 over Nongshim RedForce but vulnerable after losses to elite squads. Their April clash saw T1 dominate HLE 2-0, fueling a heated rematch where HLE's ex-T1 stars Zeus and Gumayusi face Faker, Oner, and Keria amid strong macro play from both. Full rosters confirmed, expect skirmish-heavy BO3 with HLE's momentum clashing against T1's veteran synergy and jungle pressure.

eventMetadata.context_description: Oklahoma City Thunder's 55.5% implied probability as 2026 NBA Champion frontrunner stems from their status as defending champions, a league-best 64-18 regular-season record securing the No. 1 overall seed, and a dominant 4-0 first-round sweep over the Suns despite minor injury concerns like Jalen Williams' hamstring tweak. Traders view their depth, led by Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Chet Holmgren, as primed for a repeat amid a favorable Western Conference path. San Antonio Spurs at 20.4% reflect their breakout 62-20 campaign and Victor Wembanyama's heroics in a 4-1 upset over Portland, advancing to the conference semifinals. Eastern contenders like Boston Celtics (8.8%) and Detroit Pistons have faltered in tight first-round series, eroding their odds as OKC-Spurs duel looms.

title: LoL: Weibo Gaming vs Invictus Gaming (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Weibo Gaming and Invictus Gaming in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for May 1 at 7:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Weibo Gaming" if Weibo Gaming win the match against Invictus Gaming.

This market will resolve to "Invictus Gaming" if Invictus Gaming win the match against Weibo Gaming.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 1: Both Teams Slay Baron Nashor?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay the Baron Nashor at least once during Game 1. Baron Nashor is a powerful neutral objective in League of Legends that first spawns at 20:00 game time and respawns 6 minutes after each death, granting the slaying team the Hand of Baron buff.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Weibo Gaming and Invictus Gaming each slay Baron Nashor at least once during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay Baron Nashor during Game 1.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

markets.question: Game 1: Both Teams Slay a Dragon?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay at least one elemental dragon during Game 1. In League of Legends, elemental dragons (Infernal, Mountain, Ocean, Hextech, Chemtech, and Cloud) spawn in the dragon pit starting at 5:00 game time. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay any elemental dragon during Game 1. Only elemental dragons count toward this market — Elder Dragon kills do not count.

eventMetadata.context_description: Weibo Gaming heads into their LPL Split 2 Group Ascend BO3 rematch against Invictus Gaming with momentum from a 2-0 upset over second-place Top Esports earlier this week, boosting their record to 3-6 while snapping a skid against elite foes. Invictus Gaming, sitting one spot higher at 3-5, seeks revenge after dropping 0-2 to surging Anyone's Legend and a prior 1-2 loss to Weibo three weeks ago in Week 3. Weibo holds a commanding 77% head-to-head winrate over the last five meetings, aided by standouts like midlaner Xiaohu and ADC Elk under fearless draft rules. Both mid-table squads battle for top-4 playoff positioning amid stable rosters and Patch 26.7 meta favoring macro execution.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: US-Iran negotiations for a permanent peace deal remain stalled in an awkward limbo of no war, no peace, following Iran's April 27 proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for ending the US naval blockade and hostilities, while postponing talks on its nuclear program and ballistic missiles. President Trump's administration expressed dissatisfaction, insisting on immediate nuclear concessions alongside sanctions relief, as reviewed in late April diplomatic channels mediated by Pakistan. A two-week ceasefire from early April has held amid extended indirect talks in Islamabad, but escalating rhetoric and hardline pressures on both sides highlight deep divides over regional security and reparations. Traders watch for breakthroughs before any resolution deadline, with historical JCPOA patterns suggesting protracted timelines amid mutual distrust.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 24 - May 1, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 24 12:00 PM ET to May 1, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

The trading session for a given business day typically begins at 6:00 PM ET on the prior calendar date.

For example, if the 25th of the month is a Saturday, the last trading session for the nearest listed contract is the session for Tuesday the 21st, and the next listed contract becomes the active month at the start of the trading session for Friday the 17th (6:00 PM ET on Thursday), assuming a standard trading calendar.

eventMetadata.context_description: WTI crude oil futures trade above $105 per barrel as of early May 2026, with trader consensus pricing in elevated Middle East supply risks from US-Iran escalation fears and potential Strait of Hormuz disruptions, fueling a 14% weekly advance and backwardation in the curve. The EIA's April 29 report revealed a 6.2 million barrel crude inventory drawdown—far exceeding expectations—leaving stocks at 459.5 million barrels, modestly above five-year seasonal averages amid record exports. OPEC+ maintains voluntary cuts through early 2026, countering robust global demand recovery. Key catalysts include weekly EIA data on May 6 and the OPEC monthly report on May 13 ahead of summer driving season.

title: Trump announces end of military operations against Iran by ...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if President Trump, the US government, or the military publicly and officially announce that their military operations against Iran, initiated on February 28, 2026, have concluded by the listed date. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Qualifying statements must clearly indicate that the operation has ended. Informal announcements, statements from unnamed sources or leaks will not qualify. 

Written public statements from Donald Trump (e.g. posts from his personal Truth Social account), will count. Videos posted on his social media accounts will also qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from the US government and/or its official representatives; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if President Trump, the US government, or the military publicly and officially announce that their military operations against Iran, initiated on February 28, 2026, have concluded by the listed date (ET). Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Qualifying statements must clearly indicate that the operation has ended. Informal announcements, statements from unnamed sources or leaks will not qualify. 

Written public statements from Donald Trump (e.g. posts from his personal Truth Social account), will count. Videos posted on his social media accounts will also qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from the US government and/or its official representatives; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: The Trump administration declared U.S. hostilities with Iran "terminated" on April 30, citing a mid-April ceasefire that reset the 60-day War Powers Resolution clock expiring today, May 1, averting a congressional authorization vote amid Democratic pressure. This follows strikes launched February 28 against Iranian targets, which Trump described as concluding the conflict in Fox News interviews around April 14-15, claiming destruction of Iran's navy and air force. However, yesterday's CENTCOM briefing presented the president with new strike options, including hypersonic missiles, as a fragile truce holds amid Iran's threats of retaliation, Strait of Hormuz tensions, and Tehran's proposal for talks. Escalation risks persist ahead of potential peace negotiations.

title: Eurovision Winner 2026
description:
This market will resolve to the country whose candidate for Eurovision 2026 wins.

If at any point it is impossible for the listed candidate to win Eurovision 2026 based on the rules of the competition (i.e. they are eliminated), this market may immediately resolve to "No".

If no winner is announced by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve "Other". All ties will be broken according to EBU's official Eurovision rules.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Eurovision (https://eurovision.tv/), including live footage of Eurovision 2026, however a consensus of credible reporting will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: Finland's "Liekinheitin" by violin virtuoso Linda Lampenius and pop star Pete Parkkonen leads trader consensus at 34.4% implied probability, propelled by its bold classical-pop fusion that dominated OGAE fan votes and bookmakers since their February UMK national final triumph, blending jury polish with massive televote appeal. Greece's Akylas ("Ferto") rallies to 17.5% on surging pre-rehearsal bets and dance-pop hooks primed for public votes, while Denmark's Søren Torpegaard Lund (12.7%) climbs with emotive ballad credentials appealing to juries. France's Monroe ("Regarde!") lingers at 8.3% on sophisticated staging potential, but the fragmented field underscores rehearsal wildcards starting today in Vienna, where production reveals and split jury-televote dynamics could upend frontrunners before the May 12-16 semis and Grand Final.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket favors California Gov. Gavin Newsom at 27% implied probability for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, reflecting his national profile from anti-Trump advocacy, executive experience, and explicit interest in a bid after the 2026 midterms, despite recent polls like Harvard/Harris (Apr. 28) showing former VP Kamala Harris leading 50-22% and Echelon Insights (Apr. 21) nearly tied at 22-21%. Harris at 12% benefits from her April 10 signal of considering another run and strong Black voter support, while Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez at 9% draws progressive and youth enthusiasm per Yale and Echelon surveys. The fragmented field highlights governors' electability edge over legislators; consolidation could follow 2026 midterm gains, Q1 2027 fundraising reports, and early Iowa/New Hampshire polling.

title: LoL: Top Esports vs Anyone's Legend (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Top Esports and Anyone's Legend in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for May 1 at 5:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Top Esports" if Top Esports win the match against Anyone's Legend.

This market will resolve to "Anyone's Legend" if Anyone's Legend win the match against Top Esports.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: Top Esports enters this LPL Split 2 Group Ascend BO3 rematch as standings leaders at 6-2 with a +8 game differential, showcasing dominant early form including a clean 2-0 Week 1 sweep over Anyone's Legend. However, TES stumbled in their latest series, falling 0-2 to Weibo Gaming, snapping a strong streak against top foes like BLG and JDG. Anyone's Legend, locked in 4th at 5-3 on a three-series win streak—including a crucial 2-0 over Invictus Gaming—has climbed into contention with improved macro play and recent roster addition Despa1r bolstering their lineup. In double round robin play, top 4 advance directly to playoffs; head-to-head favors TES, but AL's momentum and Game 1 upset via chunky Sion teamfight signal a competitive series amid the current patch's skirmish-heavy meta.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket positions HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. as the clear frontrunner at 49% for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, driven by his Make America Healthy Again (MAHA) agenda's broad appeal and polling strength among GOP voters, including a March 2026 surge amid reports of his cousin confirming a likely bid. Vice President J.D. Vance follows at 38.5%, benefiting from incumbency and MAGA loyalty but tempered by recent foreign policy critiques in voter focus groups. Marco Rubio's 20.8% reflects rising perceptions of competence as a stabilizing figure post-Trump era. High-volume trading over $500M underscores skin-in-the-game bets on RFK's cabinet popularity and midterm boosts from MAHA alliances, with 2026 primaries looming as key tests.

title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by end of April?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and April 30, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. markets.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by end of April?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and April 30, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for April 30, 2026, however, will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket has priced the "No" outcome at a market-implied 100% probability, reflecting skin-in-the-game certainty that Strait of Hormuz shipping traffic failed to normalize by April 30 amid the ongoing US-Iran war now in its ninth week. Latest Kpler and MarineTraffic data through April 29 show daily transits at just 5-12 vessels—versus a pre-crisis average of 130-140—down over 95% per UN estimates, due to the US naval blockade turning back dozens of ships and Iran's tightened controls favoring only shadow fleet and low-risk dry bulk. This persistent chokepoint disruption, handling 20% of global oil trade, sustains elevated geopolitical risk premiums in energy markets. Tail risks include an abrupt US-Iran deal or ceasefire extension, though deepening deadlock makes normalization improbable absent major concessions.

title: Presidential Election Winner 2028
description:
The 2028 US Presidential Election is scheduled to take place on November 7, 2028.

This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No.”

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

title: Indian Premier League: Rajasthan Royals vs Delhi Capitals
description:
This market refers to the cricket match between Rajasthan Royals and Delhi Capitals scheduled for May 1 2026 in Indian Premier League.

This market resolves according to the finalized match result as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.  

DLS/DRS, over-rate penalties, forfeit/walkover, or any other on-field ruling that leads the competition to declare a winner are treated as ordinary wins.

If the match ends tied and the playing conditions provide an on-field tiebreak (e.g., Super Over), the winner determined by that tiebreak will be used for resolution. If the match ends tied and no on-field tiebreak is used or available under the playing conditions (e.g., group-stage ODI with no Super Over), the market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed/rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed. If the match is permanently canceled or abandoned or otherwise is completed without a winner, the market resolves 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

eventMetadata.context_description: Rajasthan Royals enter their home clash against Delhi Capitals at Sawai Mansingh Stadium in Jaipur as frontrunners eyeing the IPL top spot, bolstered by recent middle-order resilience and a strong record on balanced pitches that typically yield high scores with dew favoring second-innings chases. title: Which company has the best AI model end of May?
description:
This market will resolve according to the company that owns the model that has the highest arena rank based on the Chatbot Arena LLM Leaderboard (https://lmarena.ai/) when the table under the "Leaderboard" tab is checked on May 31, 2026, 12:00 PM ET.

Results from the "Rank" column under the "Text Arena | Overall" Leaderboard tab at https://lmarena.ai/leaderboard/text with style control off will be used to resolve this market.

Models will be ordered primarily by their leaderboard rank at the market’s check time. If two or more models are tied on rank, they will be ordered by their Arena score, including any underlying, unrounded, granular values reflected in the data below the leaderboard. If a tie remains, alphabetical order of company names as listed in this market group will be used as a final tiebreaker (e.g., if the two models are tied by exact arena score, “Google” would be ranked ahead of “xAI”). This market will resolve based on the company that occupies first place under this ranking system.

The resolution source for this market is the Chatbot Arena LLM Leaderboard found at https://lmarena.ai/. If this resolution source is unavailable at check time, this market will remain open until the leaderboard comes back online and will resolve based on the first check after it becomes available. If it becomes permanently unavailable, this market will resolve based on another resolution source.

title: Madrid Open: Jannik Sinner vs Arthur Fils
description:

eventMetadata.context_description: Top-seeded Jannik Sinner faces resurgent Arthur Fils in the Madrid Open ATP Masters 1000 semifinals on high-altitude clay, where Sinner holds a 1-0 head-to-head edge from their 2023 Montpellier semifinal win. Sinner, unbeaten at 9-0 on clay in 2026 with a 26-match Masters 1000 streak, dispatched qualifier Rafael Jodar in straight sets during Wednesday's quarterfinals, showcasing baseline dominance despite minor pre-tournament shoulder concerns. Fils, 22-5 since February's return from an eight-month back injury layoff, powered past Jiri Lehecka 6-3, 6-4 with aggressive forehands, maintaining his own perfect clay mark this year. Madrid's elevated bounce favors power hitters, but Sinner's serving consistency and recent form shape trader consensus amid no fresh injury reports.

title: Fed Decision in June?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's June 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for June 16-17, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

eventMetadata.context_description: Polymarket traders price a 95.5% implied probability of no change in the federal funds rate at the June 16-17 FOMC meeting, reflecting strong consensus after the Federal Reserve's April 28-29 decision to hold rates steady at 3.50%-3.75%. This positioning stems from elevated inflation—March CPI rose 3.3% year-over-year, the highest since May 2024, with PCE inflation hitting 3.5%—coupled with a resilient labor market showing stable unemployment despite modest job gains of 178,000 in March. Chair Powell's April 29 remarks highlighted persistent price pressures, tempering cut expectations absent further cooling. Realistic challenges include unexpectedly weak May nonfarm payrolls or CPI data signaling disinflation, potentially shifting trader sentiment ahead of the meeting.

title: Who will be confirmed as Fed Chair?
description:
This market will resolve according to the next individual formally confirmed as Chair of the Federal Reserve.

Formal confirmation as Chair of the Federal Reserve requires the Senate to confirm a nominee as Chair of the Federal Reserve. Recess appointments without Senate confirmation will not count. Senate confirmation of a listed individual as a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors will not alone qualify.

If no Senate confirmation for the position of Chair of the Federal Reserve has occurred by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market is official information from the U.S. Senate; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Kevin Warsh's commanding 99.4% implied probability as next Federal Reserve Chair stems from the Senate Banking Committee's 13-11 party-line approval of his nomination on April 29, advancing it to the full Senate floor vote ahead of Jerome Powell's May 15 term end. President Trump's nominee cleared the April 21 confirmation hearing despite Democratic opposition led by Sen. Elizabeth Warren, with reports of potential crossover support from Sen. John Fetterman bolstering the path. Republican Senate majority ensures procedural momentum via simple majority confirmation, reflecting trader consensus on institutional precedents for such appointments. Realistic challenges include floor holds, unexpected defections, scandals, or procedural delays, though Powell's pledge to step aside as chair reduces interim uncertainty.

title: Will the Iranian regime fall by May 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Islamic Republic of Iran’s current ruling regime is overthrown, collapsed, or otherwise ceases to govern by May 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This requires a broad consensus of reporting indicating that core structures of the Islamic Republic (e.g. the office of the Supreme Leader, the Guardian Council, IRGC control under clerical authority) have been dissolved, incapacitated, or replaced by a fundamentally different governing system or otherwise lost de facto power over a majority of the population of Iran. This could occur via revolution, civil war, military coup, or voluntary abdication, but only qualifies if the Islamic Republic no longer exercises sovereign power.

Routine political events such as elections, reforms, or leadership succession do not qualify. Internal coups or power shifts that preserve the Islamic Republic’s core structures also do not qualify. Only a clear break in continuity—such as a new provisional government, revolutionary council, or constitution replacing the Islamic Republic will qualify.

markets.question: Will the Iranian regime fall by May 31?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Islamic Republic of Iran’s current ruling regime is overthrown, collapsed, or otherwise ceases to govern by May 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This requires a broad consensus of reporting indicating that core structures of the Islamic Republic (e.g. the office of the Supreme Leader, the Guardian Council, IRGC control under clerical authority) have been dissolved, incapacitated, or replaced by a fundamentally different governing system or otherwise lost de facto power over a majority of the population of Iran. This could occur via revolution, civil war, military coup, or voluntary abdication, but only qualifies if the Islamic Republic no longer exercises sovereign power.

Only a clear break in continuity—such as a new provisional government, revolutionary council, or constitution replacing the Islamic Republic will qualify.

Partial loss of territory or challenges from rebel or exile groups will not qualify unless the Islamic Republic no longer administers the majority of the Iranian population within Iran. 

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

Separation could come from June-August party conventions, economic data releases, confirmation hearings on Flávio's recent police probe, or Lula's health at age 79.

title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by May 15?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and May 15, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for May 31, 2026, however, will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

eventMetadata.context_description: Ongoing US-Iran hostilities, including mutual naval blockades of the Strait of Hormuz, have kept commercial shipping traffic below 10% of pre-war levels—down from 120-140 daily transits to just a handful—as of May 1, sustaining trader consensus at 93.5% odds against normalization by May 15. Iran closed the waterway on February 28 amid the conflict's escalation, with brief ceasefire reopenings collapsing due to alleged violations; most recently, Tehran offered to lift restrictions on April 27 if the US ends its blockade on Iranian ports, but Washington instead pursued an international coalition on April 30 amid threats of renewed attacks. Minimal AIS-visible crossings persist via Iranian-controlled routes, with no diplomatic breakthrough or de-escalation signals in sight.

title: F1 Drivers' Champion
description:
This market will resolve according to the listed driver that finishes 1st in the driver standings for the 2026 F1 season.

This market will resolve as soon as the official results of the final scheduled race of the 2026 F1 season are known.

If multiple drivers tie for first place in the drivers standings, this market will resolve according to the tiebreak procedure used by F1 to determine the 2026 F1 Drivers’ champion.

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed driver to win the 2026 F1 Drivers Championship based on the rules of F1 (e.g., they are mathematically eliminated from contention), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the F1 season is permanently canceled or has not been completed by February 28, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Formula 1.

eventMetadata.context_description: Mercedes' superior adaptation to 2026 regulations has propelled teammates George Russell and Kimi Antonelli to the top of trader consensus for the F1 Drivers' Championship, with Russell's 41.5% implied probability edging Antonelli's 31.8% despite the Italian rookie's 72-63 points lead after three grands prix. Antonelli's back-to-back victories in China and Japan, plus a P2 in Australia, mark his breakout, but Russell's consistency—highlighted by strong qualifying head-to-heads and podiums—bolsters his favoritism among bettors valuing experience amid intra-team rivalry. Ferrari's Charles Leclerc trails in third at 49 points, reflecting Mercedes' early constructors' edge, while Red Bull's Max Verstappen lags due to uncompetitive race pace, keeping others below 7%. Upcoming Miami Grand Prix could shift dynamics with potential reliability concerns.

eventMetadata.context_description: The Lakers hold a 3-2 series lead over the Rockets in their Western Conference first-round NBA playoffs matchup, with Game 6 set for tonight at Toyota Center in Houston. Recent momentum favors the Rockets, who rallied from a 3-0 deficit to win Games 4 and 5 on the road without Kevin Durant, sidelined by a left ankle bone bruise that will keep him out again. The Lakers continue without Luka Dončić due to a Grade 2 hamstring strain expected to sideline him through the series, though Austin Reaves returned in Game 5 after a nine-game oblique absence. LeBron James remains pivotal amid shooting struggles, while home-court advantage and back-to-back wins boost Houston's upset potential in this elimination game.

title: Next French Presidential Election
description:
The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent polls following March 2026 municipal elections, where Rassemblement National (RN) failed to capture major cities despite strong national support, position Jordan Bardella and Édouard Philippe as co-frontrunners with 30-34% first-round voting intentions each, per Elabe/BFMTV and Odoxa surveys through late April. This trader consensus at 21.5% apiece reflects France's fragmented political landscape—a hung parliament since 2024 snap legislative elections—and voter desire for change after Emmanuel Macron's term ends in 2027, with no incumbent advantage. Philippe's runoff edge over Bardella in matchups bolsters his viability as a centrist Horizons leader post-Le Havre mayoral reelection, while RN's internal shift from Marine Le Pen sustains Bardella's momentum. The race stays tight amid undecided left-wing consolidation and undecided primaries; separation could arise from party nominations, economic shocks, or scandals before April 2027 voting.

title: US x Iran diplomatic meeting by...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is a diplomatic meeting between representatives of the United States and Iran by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A diplomatic meeting refers to a deliberate meeting between representatives of the listed countries who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to engage in negotiation or diplomacy regarding US-Iranian relations on behalf of their governments. Meetings conducted indirectly, for example, through designated mediators, facilitators, or interlocutors acting with the knowledge and authorization of the relevant governments, will qualify. 

Brief greetings, chance encounters, or talks otherwise not deliberately aimed at diplomacy or negotiation will not count. 

The meeting must be in-person and must be publicly acknowledged by either government or reported by a consensus of credible media. Remote meetings, phone calls, or other meetings where the relevant parties are not present will not count.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran, and a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: US-Iran diplomatic negotiations remain deadlocked after mid-April indirect talks in Islamabad collapsed without a direct high-level meeting, despite planned US delegations led by Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner. Iran submitted a fresh 10-point peace proposal via Pakistani mediators on May 1, prioritizing Strait of Hormuz reopening and regional de-escalation while deferring nuclear discussions, prompting White House review amid firm insistence that Tehran cannot possess nuclear weapons. President Trump canceled in-person trips, shifting to phone diplomacy under an extended ceasefire from the February conflict, with no new summit dates set. Upcoming US national security deliberations and potential Pakistani-hosted rounds represent key catalysts, though persistent gaps on nuclear curbs and Hormuz access sustain uncertainty for trader consensus.
